domain.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf side of the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire: RMM creates a case, releases a rule-derived scope, the supplier answers in a separate portal, and only the affected departments (REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM) review on one CIQ Review Track each, with Safety and Regulatory recording RMES results/findings and taking final decisions. The last finishing department advances the case (G5); the supplier's final release (or RMM manual completion) and an optional overall approval end it. Configuration is versioned JSON data released four-eyes and pinned per case; registers, confirmations and a hash-chained audit make every step traceable. This domain covers 28 app flows (25 Forms + 3 Processes: CIQ Case, CIQ Review Track, CIQ Config Release; A12/A13 dropped by v2), 33 CIQ lists, 18 custom roles + Admin/User, and the §7.2 grant matrix. Part A (v2 overrides + naming contract) overrides the plan; every override and knock-on is listed in overrides_applied and runs/current/open-questions.md. The supplier portal is an external system with no app access for suppliers. Field types appear only where the source states them (contract fields, plan field lists) as quoted evidence, not as design.

journeys.name: Create a CIQ case
journeys.trigger: RMM decides to qualify a supplier raw material (a future Teamcenter/IRMA webhook may start it; keys stored now)
steps: Validate every mandatory input before any write (REQ-PROC-001)
Create CIQ Case at Start "Create case": Case_Code (app-generated, collision-checked on CIQ Case Index), header, Case_Supplier, Raw_Material, Production_Site, Owner_RMM, Target_Markets, due dates
Pin the published release: Release_Key + domain keys and Release_Hash (copied from the CIQ Config Release Manifest_Hash); Overall_Approval_Required copied from the pinned Settings
Write CIQ Case Contact rows (the per-case access list)
The RMM session creates the portal request (out of scope here) and stores Portal_Request_Item_Id
Write the CASE lane on CIQ Case Index, an audit event and notification-log rows
journeys.outcome: Case at "Part 1 – with supplier"; supplier has access and a task in the portal
journeys.frequency: Once per case and cycle; volumes "tens of cases" (default)
success_criteria: Missing mandatory fields block creation
The case pins one release bundle and its hash
Only named case contacts get supplier access

journeys.name: Check and release the scope (G3)
journeys.trigger: Supplier submits basic data and configuration in the portal (G2)
steps: Read the BASIC answers and run the evaluator on the pinned rule set
Write one CIQ Scope Run (full result including N.A. sections with reasons, Departments_Activated, Run_Hash), written once
Optionally extend the scope manually: justification mandatory, audited
Release M/O sections to the portal (portal side out of scope)
Write Dept_*_Active on CIQ Case (lead department of each M/O section under the pinned ownership)
Write a Scope release confirmation, the department lanes, the Pending CIQ Portal Link row for G4b, and audit
journeys.outcome: Scope released; departments to activate are known
success_criteria: Same input + same version gives the same result (REQ-PROC-009)
N.A. sections kept internally with their reason (REQ-PROC-010)
A manual extension cannot be saved without a justification

journeys.name: Extend the scope (additions only)
journeys.trigger: A configuration answer changes (Part 1), RMM extends manually, or a reviewer activates an additional part in Part 2

Manual extension: mandatory justification, audited in CIQ Audit Event
Part 2 activation: set the department flag, create the lane and a late-activation track (see j14)
journeys.outcome: Scope grows; nothing already in scope is removed

journeys.name: Review a department's sections and complete the review
journeys.trigger: A department's step "Review – <department>" is entered on its CIQ Review Track
steps: Read the supplier's answers and documents (BDF never edits CIQ answers)
Mark sections in review/reviewed on the own lane
Raise open points where needed (j06)
Completion gate: refuse while an open point, a pending applicable RMES result, a negative result without comment or an open blocking finding exists; name each blocker
Write a Department completion confirmation; set Track_Closed = Yes (departments without a decision step); submit the review step
Set the lane to Completed (Ready for decision for SAF/REG); departments without a decision step run the G5 check
journeys.outcome: Department review completed (or ready for the SAF/REG decision)
journeys.frequency: Once per activated department per case and cycle
success_criteria: Only the matching role can complete its department step
Completion confirmation says "Review completed — not a raw-material approval" (REQ-PROC-038)
Every blocker is named with type, section, status and responsible person

journeys.name: Raise and resolve an open point
journeys.trigger: A reviewer needs an answer, a document or an additional part from the supplier, or a finding needs a query
steps: Create the portal query (out of scope) with a mandatory reference to a question or document
Create the internal twin CIQ Open Point: internal justification, responsible user, internal due date, blocking flag
The supplier answers in the portal; answers are mirrored into the twin rounds
Accept, return (send-back with supplier-facing reason) or close as not accepted with internal rationale
Additional part: new section in the portal, scope run, late-activation track if missing
journeys.outcome: Open point closed with an outcome; twin no longer open
success_criteria: No reference, no send (REQ-PROC-029)
Only the owning department decides (REQ-PROC-034)
Each round kept (REQ-PROC-033)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L175; brd.md L321; brd.md L398; brd.md L400; brd.md L613; brd.md L752; brd.md L754

journeys.name: Record RMES results and findings
journeys.trigger: First Safety (or Regulatory) session after intake
steps: Create the department's result rows from the pinned RMES criteria (idempotent by Result_Key)
Prefill from the supplier's answers with source keys (question, or document by file name + upload date)
Record Criterion_Result, comment, reported value and unit; limit check against the pinned limit set
A limit exceedance creates a blocking finding automatically
Confirm or discard AI suggestions (marked, sourced)
Every change writes an audit event with old and new value and the data value / document the assessment was based on
journeys.outcome: Current-state RMES rows per department with traceable sources
journeys.frequency: Per case and cycle when SAF/REG activated
success_criteria: Regulatory cannot edit Safety rows and vice versa (REQ-CFG-004, REQ-RMES-003, -011)
N.A. rows stay visible (REQ-RMES-004)
Sources traceable (REQ-RMES-005)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L53; brd.md L409; brd.md L410; brd.md L411; brd.md L412; brd.md L755

journeys.name: Take the final Safety / Regulatory decision
journeys.trigger: The Safety or Regulatory review step is completed (lane Ready for decision)
steps: Repeat the RMES gate: no pending applicable criterion, no open blocking finding
Write the decision hash on the CIQ RMES Record
Write the Final Safety/Regulatory decision confirmation
Set Track_Decision (reason mandatory on rejection) and Track_Closed; submit the decision step
Set the lane to Approved or Rejected; run the G5 check
journeys.outcome: Safety/Regulatory track ended with a decision
success_criteria: SAF/REG count as finished only after the decision step
No approval with a pending criterion or open blocking finding (REQ-RMES-006, -009, -013)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L61; brd.md L595; brd.md L596; brd.md L599; brd.md L757

journeys.name: Advance the case after the last department (G5)
journeys.trigger: A session finishes a track (last review step for QM, MIC, SUS, RMM; decision step for SAF, REG)
steps: Write the own lane first, then list the case's lanes and compare with Departments_Activated
Advance only if every activated lane is terminal (Completed; Approved/Rejected for SAF and REG), each confirmed against its track where possible, and no open point of the case is open
Set Any_Dept_Rejected; set Release_Path (see open questions); if no release is requested, write the neutral Supplier_Notice_Text
Submit "Part 2 – Beiersdorf review"; I-6 mirrors the result to the portal (not authored here)
journeys.outcome: Case leaves Part 2 exactly once
success_criteria: Ready for decision is never terminal
A second simultaneous finisher finds the step moved and stops
G5 is the point of no return for the cycle

AS-02 path (a department rejected): only Reject offered
Set Overall_Decision and Overall_Reason (required on rejection); write the Overall decision confirmation and audit
At End, I-4 renders the final PDF, e-mails Owner_RMM and registers it in CIQ Final Document (I-4 authoring is an open question)
journeys.outcome: Case completed or rejected; final PDF filed with its hash
journeys.frequency: Once per case when overall approval is switched on

business_rules.statement: Track_Decision is read-only at Start and mandatory at the two decision steps; a native Reject on a track is read as Track_Decision = Rejected with the comment as reason; Reject is disabled on review steps 1–6 where possible.

On completion: write a Department completion confirmation, set Track_Closed = Yes (departments without a decision step), submit, set the lane to Completed (Ready for decision for SAF/REG).

At the decision step: repeat the RMES gate (no pending criterion, no open blocking finding; reason mandatory on rejection), write the decision confirmation, set Track_Decision and Track_Closed, submit, lane Approved or Rejected.

G5 sync: the finishing session writes its own lane, lists the case lanes, and advances only if every activated lane is terminal (Completed; Approved/Rejected for SAF and REG), each confirmed by a direct read of its track where possible, and no open point of the case is open; it then sets Any_Dept_Rejected and, if no release will be requested, Supplier_Notice_Text, and submits Part 2.
